The plan should explicitly instruct the auditor to focus on 'flipper structural integrity' rather than standard joint angles.

audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sea lion resting on a rocky surface. The animal is lying on its side with its head tucked down and eyes closed. A large foreflipper is prominently displayed in the foreground, draped over the rock. The fur appears short, coarse, and golden-brown. Visible external ear flaps confirm it is an otariid (eared seal).

Long, light-colored whiskers are clearly visible extending from the muzzle area against the darker fur of the neck/flipper.
